{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Mexico|Mexican cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Southwestern cuisine|Southwestern cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] 
==Ingredients==

* 3 ripe [[Cookbook:Avocado|avocados]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Lime|lime juice]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] of [[Cookbook:Salsa Fresca|salsa fresca]]

==Procedure==

# Peel and [[Cookbook:Dice|dice]] avocados.
# Sprinkle the avocados with lime juice.
# Add salsa fresca, and toss to mix.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* If you don't plan on serving immediately, place an avocado pit in the bowl to prevent browning, cover tightly with [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]], and store in refrigerator.
